item.text: I see the WhatsApp export has messages with `first_number` - counts extracted from messages. I need to filter for attendance-related messages (words like "bacche", "aaye", "attendance", etc.) and aggregate by date.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, first_number FROM \\\"whatsapp_field_group_export_messages\\\" WHERE lower(message) LIKE '%bacche%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%aaye%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%attendance%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%attende%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%child%' OR lower(message) LIKE '%present%'\""

item.text: Let me aggregate by date, filtering only rows where `first_number` is not null and greater than 0, then find the top days.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, first_number FROM \\\"whatsapp_field_group_export_messages\\\" WHERE first_number IS NOT NULL AND first_number > 0 ORDER BY date, first_number\""
/bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, first_number FROM \\\"whatsapp_field_group_export_messages\\\" WHERE first_number IS NOT NULL AND first_number > 0 ORDER BY date, first_number\""

item.text: Now let me aggregate total children reported per day and get the top days.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "python3 io.py query \"SELECT date, SUM(first_number) as total_children FROM \\\"whatsapp_field_group_export_messages\\\" WHERE first_number IS NOT NULL AND first_number > 0 GROUP BY date ORDER BY total_children DESC LIMIT 10\""
